records.title: Spandana: Reconciling Strict SLOs with Low Cost under Fine-Grained Load Fluctuations
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: Cloud-based online services face significant sub-second load fluctuations while needing to meet strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs). records.title: APRIL-MedSeg: A Modular Medical Image Segmentation Toolbox Embracing Modern Paradigms
